=== default build ===
rm -f planb64
g++  -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -std=c++17 planb64.cpp   -o planb64
-rwxr-xr-x    1 64001    64001        52592 Nov  8 08:10 planb64
=== external CXXFLAGS (-O2 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror) ===
rm -f planb64
g++  -O2 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -std=c++17 planb64.cpp   -o planb64
=== external CXXFLAGS (-O0) ===
rm -f planb64
g++  -O0 -std=c++17 planb64.cpp   -o planb64
=== external CXXFLAGS with sanitizers ===
rm -f planb64
g++  -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -std=c++17 planb64.cpp   -o planb64
=== CXXFLAGS as environment variable ===
rm -f planb64
g++  -O2 -std=c++17 -std=c++17 planb64.cpp   -o planb64
=== make with no changes ===
make: Nothing to be done for 'all'.
